name: DataRobot
tagline: DataRobot is an automated machine learning platform that allows data teams to build, deploy, and monitor predictive models without deep ML expertise. It automates the most time-consuming steps — feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning — while giving data scientists full control over every decision. Enterprises use DataRobot to operationalise AI across risk, marketing, operations, and supply chain.
